contea di ritrovamento: Worcestershire (Inghilterra e Galles)

An incomplete copper alloy Roman nummus of Constantine I dating to AD 321 (Reece period 16). BEATATRAN [*** QV]ILLITAS reverse type depicting globe set on altar inscribed with VOT/IS/XX. Trier mint. RIC 304 (vol. VII p. 190). Coin is chipped around the edge. Coin measures 17.5mm in length and 20mm in width
